estimates.assumptions: 400 g drained chickpeas (standard drained weight from a 400 g can; ~14 g protein and 116 kcal per 100 g drained)
1 tbsp (15 g) tahini paste (standard values ~595 kcal, 17 g protein, 54 g fat per 100 g)
1 large garlic clove (~6 g; standard values ~149 kcal and 6.4 g protein per 100 g)
3 tbsp (45 g) non-fat or low-fat Greek yogurt (standard values ~59 kcal and 10 g protein per 100 g for 0% fat type)
Juice of half a lemon (~30 g juice; standard values ~22 kcal per 100 g, negligible protein/fat)
